mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS movieId, m.title, m.poster_url AS posterUrl, IFNULL(SUM(t.price), 0) AS boxOffice, COUNT(t.id) AS soldCount, IFNULL(m.total_box, 0) AS totalBox FROM movie m JOIN schedule s ON s.movie_id = m.id JOIN ticket t ON t.schedule_id = s.id JOIN `order` o ON o.id = t.order_id WHERE t.status = 0 AND t.order_id != -1 AND o.status IN (2, 6) GROUP BY m.id HAVING boxOffice > 0 ORDER BY boxOffice DESC, soldCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.id AS movieId, m.title, m.poster_url AS posterUrl, 0 AS boxOffice, 0 AS soldCount, IFNULL(m.total_box, 0) AS totalBox FROM movie m WHERE m.total_box > 0 ORDER BY m.total_box DESC LIMIT #{limit}
